title: The Tan Cat
lines: Liz has a sun hat on a rug.
A tan cat hops up and naps on the hat.
"The cat is on the hat!" said Liz.
"Do not tap the cat," said Zeb.
Zeb gets a pan and taps on it.
The cat hops up and runs to the tub.
Liz has the hat. A mud dot is on top.
Liz rubs at the mud dot.
"The cat can have the rug," said Zeb.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
